services.name: Wine Tastings
services.desc: The wine tasting is going on summer vacation and will resume on October 26th at its usual 7:30PM. As we will be entering what we hope will be a season of celebration, we will be tasting a collection of sparkling wines from around the world. Some of these wines will come from California and the Champagne region of France plus some other interesting places. Advanced signup is required. If interested, please sign up by sending us email at wine-rsvp@neophilic.com. ​Founded in the late 19th century by a group of Berkeley women to promote good design practices in the Berkeley hills, the Hillside Club today is a community-based membership organization dedicated to supporting the arts and culture
